name: agy
label: Antigravity CLI
install: Install the Antigravity CLI (https://antigravity.google/docs/install?tab=cli) and set GEMINI_API_KEY
auth: GEMINI_API_KEY in the environment (the same key the image step uses). The profile's isolated home sets "modelProvider": "gemini", which headless use needs: the key alone has no effect, and agy never reads a .env file.
_toolPolicy: No per-tool allowlist: --dangerously-skip-permissions auto-approves every call, so the prompt's contract is the only rule.
_isolatedHome: Runs from a throwaway home, not yours: with a user's MCP servers configured, headless agy sends the message and never starts the turn (1.4.7, 2026-10-26), and a recipe run shouldn't see those servers anyway.
_prompt: --print takes no stdin, and the longest recipe prompts pass Windows' 32k command-line limit, so the agent is told to read the prompt file.
argv: --print=Your full task is in the file .prompt.md in the current folder. Read it and do exactly what it says.

verified.liveRunNote: short-story, 2026-10-26: 2,074 words in 3 min, default model, GEMINI_API_KEY
